_note: Test set for CLARIX, matched to products.csv. Stock levels, lead times and bulk prices in that file are SAMPLE data. VAT is 15%. 'must_include' / 'must_not_include' are auto-checked by run_eval.py (commas and spaces inside numbers are ignored, case ignored). 'expected' is for you to judge by eye.
